summary: This room's five targets (LoRA Trainer, OBS, Search Before You Build, The Aftermath Frame, Tool Builder) turned out to be under-linked for an ordinary reason, not a bad one: each is genuinely new and its neighbors simply haven't caught up. Every walk surfaced real inbound candidates — nothing here was forced. Two things stood out. First, a small cluster of Shop specialists already name each other in body prose (ComfyUI's own open question is answered, word for word, by LoRA Trainer's existence; Loudon Live Design System's asset tree is full of "OBS scene templates" it never cites in frontmatter) — the knowledge is already written, just not wired. Second, three independent entries — Maker, OBS, and Loudon Live Post-producer — are each separately pressing on the same unnamed architectural gap (a "Producer layer" above Maker's dispatch model), from three different angles, without citing each other. That convergence is worth an elder's eye before it gets patched three separate ways. "Block It in Blender, Ink It in genAI," itself an unreached newcomer, turned out to be the literal runbook for The Aftermath Frame's own stated forward vector (pen-flow ink), so wiring it serves both entries at once.

walk_results.note: RunPod GPU Backend is the GPU substrate LoRA Trainer's own body already names ('rides Shop/RunPod GPU Backend for the compute'), so the reverse enables-link is a plain gap, not a stretch. ComfyUI (Shop/ComfyUI.md:212) carries its own dated open question — 'Training a Loudon Live LoRA on a small reference set — when does this become worth the effort?' — that LoRA Trainer, born after it, now answers with a hardened recipe and an honest grading method. The Shop's roster table already lists LoRA Trainer in-body (line 121) but that's expected hub behavior, not a gap worth wiring.

LDN RTM and Closing Well already name OBS in body prose but are covered — OBS's own frontmatter already points at both (first-job, screenshot-is-the-verify), so no new link needed there. Three genuine misses: Maker's Open Questions (line 318) about a Producer layer is directly echoed by OBS's own forward_vector ('the second independent pressure on the Shop's Producer-layer seam'); Loudon Live Design System's body is full of OBS scene-template references it never cites in frontmatter; Loudon Live Post-producer names OBS explicitly to mark a capability boundary (chat/cross-posting) in its own open questions.

Return Ceremony's existing exemplifies-link is correct and already accounts for the 1 inbound. Two genuine misses: Adopt the Craft, Author the Seam is explicitly called its 'internal twin' in Search Before You Build's own body, but doesn't link back; GenAI Camera's own gotcha section (the depth-flat fix, bench.py) is the exact incident Search Before You Build cites as its origin story, so a spawned-link closes the loop.

Andy Goldsworthy already links here (mirrors-adjacent connects-to, resistance-is-information) — confirmed correct, not a new find. The one genuine miss: 'Block It in Blender, Ink It in genAI,' itself an unreached newcomer (0 inbound), is the literal runbook for the pen-flow-ink pipeline The Aftermath Frame names as its own forward vector's whole point — wiring it serves both entries.
